messages:
julie: Kicking off a staged rollout for serving v2.4.1-hotfix in the 23:00-01:00 UTC change window. Starting at 2% in eu-west. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/serving-v2.4.1-hotfix — this contains the null-check fix for embed pipeline. tagging release/serving-v2.4.1-hotfix
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: service=serving target=release/serving-v2.4.1-hotfix region=eu-west percent=2
deploy-bot: Command: `rctl rollout start --service serving --tag release/serving-v2.4.1-hotfix --region eu-west --percent 2`
mike: Observability heads-up: seeing a little 95th p95 increase in eu-west edge nodes ~ +1.2s on embed calls since 30s after shift. Not a ton of errors but latency tail is up.
nana: @mike can you post the grafana panel? curious if it's KV cache or GPU queueing.
mike: pasted snapshot -> https://grafana/redwood/d/serving?orgId=1&panelId=95 (short) p95 spiked from 120ms -> 1.3s, cpu/gpu utilization fine, queue depth ticked up on a few hosts
ana: hmm could be a branch that didn't handle empty context. we have a repro locally. recommend pausing and pinning eu-west back to v2.4.0 until we verify. +1 rollback
julie: hold the rollout. @deploy-bot can you stop the percent shift and pin traffic back to release v2.4.0 in eu-west? change window still active but want to be safe. :exclamation:
deploy-bot: Executing stop: `rctl rollout stop --service serving --region eu-west`
deploy-bot: Pinning traffic: `rctl traffic pin --service serving --region eu-west --version v2.4.0`
deploy-bot: Done — traffic pinned to v2.4.0 in eu-west. Rollout halted.
sre-ops: Confirming incidents: no 5xx surge, just latency tail. We'll capture request traces and sample failing payloads. Starting hotfix branch deploy review. ETA ~20m for patch + test.
james: Suggest we run the hotfix in a dedicated small canary pool (gpu-dedicated) to validate before reattempting percent shift. Less blast radius and isolates KV cache effects.\ulie: (typo) meant julie: Good call. After patch and run on dedicated canary we can reattempt 2% then 5% with 15m observation windows.
nana: I'll open a short postmortem note and link the failing traces, will include repro and test steps.
mike: LGTM — once pinned and sample collected, we can coordinate the re-rollout. :thumbsup:
james: I'll queue the hotfix build and notify when the dedicated canary is ready.
julie: Thanks all — pausing here. Follow-up: patch PR -> testing on gpu-dedicated -> re-run canary -> staged percent with 15m checks. If any p95 > 700ms or error rate > 0.5% we abort and pin.
deploy-bot: Note: change-window ends at 01:00 UTC. If patch not ready before end, we will schedule off-window deploy and keep eu-west pinned.
julie: ack. filing follow-up ticket and release notes update. :spiral_note_pad:
